# sonarqube_permission_template_default (Resource)

The default permission template for one kind of component. Destroying it reverts to the built-in default template. Import ID: the qualifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_permission_template" "projects" {
  name = "projects"
}

resource "sonarqube_permission_template_default" "projects" {
  template_id = sonarqube_permission_template.projects.id
  qualifier   = "TRK"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `qualifier` (String) `TRK` (projects), `APP` (applications) or `VW` (portfolios).
- `template_id` (String) Template ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_permission_template_default.example 'TRK'
```
